features.description: Optional protocol additions this server accepts. typing_actions: the action field on typing frames. message_requests: requests («Запрос») — the request REST routes, Message.request and the request.* events. message_reminders: personal reminders («Напомнить мне») — the reminder REST routes and the reminder.* events. org_structure: departments and positions («Оргструктура») — the org REST routes, the org fields of ActorSummary, OrganizationMember and Message, mentioned_department_ids in message, request and scheduled message bodies, the department and position request audiences and the org.updated event. message_tasks: tasks («Задача») — the task REST routes, GET /api/v1/inbox/waiting, Message.task, the task fields of the unread snapshot and the task.updated and task.notified events. message_polls: polls («Опрос») — the poll REST routes, Message.poll and Message.poll_viewer, kind=polls of GET /api/v1/inbox/waiting, the poll fields of the unread snapshot and the poll.updated, poll.vote.updated and poll.notified events. actor_away: «Отсутствую» — GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/me/away, GET /api/v1/me/substituting, the away field of User, ActorSummary, ChatMember and OrganizationMember, presence on GET /api/v1/actors, Message.auto_reply and the actor.away.updated, away.substitute.assigned and away.substitute.removed events. A client hides a feature the server does not list.

actor_id.description: Who caused the event. null when the server must not or cannot tell: always for poll.updated (a vote must not reveal the voter) and for poll.notified with kind closed_expired, which the server sends by itself. Clients never rely on it being set.

data.description: Event payload. For message.created, message.updated and message.deleted it is the message in the shape of the REST feed (components/schemas/Message: files with metadata and no links, thread_reply_count, mentioned_actor_ids, blocks, agent_provenance and request when present; never request_viewer, which is per reader), read when the event is delivered, plus silent on message.created and thread_root_reply_count on thread replies. A frame that would exceed the frame limit (WS_MAX_FRAME_BYTES) is never sent as is: its data becomes a stub with truncated: true — for message.* the Message shape with an empty body, no files and no blocks, for other events only their short scalar fields — and the client loads the record by REST. The data of request.* and reminder.* events is described by the RequestAssignedEvent … ReminderFiredEvent definitions: it never carries message text, notes, comments or who answered what. The data of org.updated is OrgUpdatedEvent: only the new version and a reason, never names or people. message.* frames of a poll carry poll (MessagePoll: never the counts of an open poll) and never poll_viewer; the data of poll.* events is PollUpdatedEvent, PollVoteUpdatedEvent and PollNotifiedEvent: never anyone's choice but the recipient's own, and no choice at all in an anonymous poll. The data of actor.away.updated and away.substitute.* is ActorAwayUpdatedEvent, AwaySubstituteAssignedEvent and AwaySubstituteRemovedEvent: never the auto-reply text or mute_push. Frames are encoded without HTML escaping.

TypingAction.description: What the person is doing in the chat; absent means typing (clients before the field).

last_seen_at.description: With away or offline: when the person left, sent only to those who share a chat with them when neither side hides last seen.

PresenceSnapshotFrame.description: Sent once after hello: everyone in the workspace who is online or away right now.

RequestAssignedEvent.description: data of request.assigned, sent only to one recipient of a new request (subject_id is the message id). Written in the same transaction before message.created so the client knows the request is addressed to it before it shows the card.

RequestUpdatedEvent.description: data of request.updated, sent to the whole chat (subject_id is the message id): an answer that changes the count, closing, a recipient leaving. Only counters: never who answered or how.

RequestTallyUpdatedEvent.description: data of request.tally.updated, sent only to the author of the request (subject_id is the message id) after any answer. Chat admins who are not the author reload listRequestAnswers on request.updated instead.

RequestAnswerUpdatedEvent.description: data of request.answer.updated, sent only to the person who answered, to all their devices (subject_id is the message id). Carries no comment text: has_comment tells whether to reload it. version is the version of the person's answer.

RequestRemindedEvent.description: data of request.reminded, sent to each recipient who has not answered (subject_id is the message id): a manual reminder by the author or the automatic one. Triggers a push.

RequestAutoRemindedEvent.description: data of request.auto_reminded, sent only to the author (subject_id is the message id): the outcome of the automatic reminder, also when everyone has answered (reminded is 0). Triggers a push.

ReminderEvent.description: data of reminder.created, reminder.updated and reminder.deleted, sent only to the owner's devices (subject_id is the reminder id). Never carries the note or the message text. reason is present on reminder.deleted only.

ReminderFiredEvent.description: data of reminder.fired, sent only to the owner's devices (subject_id is the reminder id). late: fired more than 15 minutes after remind_at. Triggers a push unless it is more than 6 hours late.

OrgUpdatedEvent.description: data of org.updated, sent to the whole workspace (chat_id null, subject_id is the organization id) once per transaction that changed the org structure, including deactivating or reactivating a person who had a membership, a position or led a department. Carries no content: the client reloads GET /api/v1/org with If-None-Match (after about 500 ms, to merge bursts) and drops the event when version is not greater than the cached one.

TaskUpdatedEvent.description: data of task.updated, sent to the whole chat (subject_id is the message id) on every change of a task except its title and description, which come as message.updated: status, due date, responsible person, items, taking, nudges, the overdue mark. task is MessageTask of openapi.yaml (the TaskUpdatedEvent schema there describes it in full); it is the same for every member, so the frame is shared. Clients replace the cached task when task.version is greater.

TaskNotifiedEvent.description: data of task.notified, sent to one person only (audience_actor_id; subject_id is the message id): the reason for a push or a toast about a task. Never carries the title, the description or item texts. kinds: assigned — the new responsible person (creation, change); unassigned — the former responsible person, no push, removes the task from «Ждут вас» on every device; item_assigned — the assignee of an item; offered — each candidate of a new queue; taken — the author, a candidate took the task; nudged — the responsible person or the candidates, «Напомнить»; due_soon — the same, one hour before due_at; overdue — the responsible person and the author; due_changed — the responsible person; completed — the author, done by someone else; reopened — the responsible person, done → open by someone else. Not written for the person who acted. On creation every task.notified is written before message.created in the same transaction.

by_actor_id.description: Who acted; null for due_soon and overdue, which the server sends by itself.

AwayPublic.description: An away status («Отсутствую», phase 6.7) as everyone in the workspace sees it. Never carries the auto-reply text, mute_push or a substitute others must not see; the owner gets those in AwayStatus (GET /api/v1/me/away).

label.description: The own text of kind other; empty for the other kinds.

active.description: starts_at <= now < ends_at at the moment the response or the event was made; clients recheck it against the clock.

substitute_id.description: Whom to write instead; null without one and while the substitute is deactivated or away themselves (checked on every read).

notifications_off.description: Push is off while the status is active: the mention hint says «уведомление не придёт».

PollUpdatedEvent.description: data of poll.updated, sent to the whole chat (subject_id is the message id; the frame actor_id is always null): a vote or a retraction that changes voter_count, closing, a member joining or leaving that changes member_count. Only the counters every member may see: final_counts is set only once the poll is closed. Clients that may see the results reload getPoll (after about 1 s, only while the card is on screen).

final_counts.description: Votes per option of a closed poll; null while it is open.

PollVoteUpdatedEvent.description: data of poll.vote.updated, sent only to the person who voted, to all their devices (subject_id is the message id): their own vote changed. In an ordinary poll it carries the chosen options (empty after «Отменить голос»); in an anonymous poll only voted: true, because the server does not know the choice.

options.description: The person's choice; empty after the vote was retracted.

PollVoteAnonymousEvent.description: poll.vote.updated of an anonymous poll: no choice at all.

PollNotifiedEvent.description: data of poll.notified, sent to one person only (audience_actor_id; subject_id is the message id): the reason for a push about a poll. Never carries the question, the options or counts. kinds: reminded — a person of the chat who has not voted, «Напомнить не ответившим» by the author (frame actor_id is the author); closed_expired — the author, the poll closed by its due date (frame actor_id null), only when the author is active, still in the chat and the chat is not archived.

ActorAwayUpdatedEvent.description: data of actor.away.updated, sent to the whole workspace like actor.status.updated (chat_id null, subject_id is the person): the away status was set, changed or removed, a planned one started, or one ended. away is null when there is none any more.

AwaySubstituteAssignedEvent.description: data of away.substitute.assigned, sent only to the substitute (audience_actor_id; subject_id is the person who is away): they were named substitute or the dates changed. Triggers a push «Вы замещаете …» (category system).

AwaySubstituteRemovedEvent.description: data of away.substitute.removed, sent only to the former substitute (audience_actor_id; subject_id is the person who was away): another substitute was named, the status was removed or it ended. No push.
